chez arabesque"},{"t":1,"s":"Mardi 1er décembre à 18h et du mercredi 2 au samedi 5 décembre de 10h à 12h et de 17h à 19h > Arabesque vous présente l’exposition de Patrick CROS.\\nVernissage le mardi 1er décembre à 18h.\\nÀ travers une peinture abstraite où la matière occupe une place centrale, l’artiste explore les contrastes entre ombre et lumière, profondeur et relief.\\nLes noirs intenses se mêlent aux nuances minérales, aux éclats dorés et aux traces blanchâtres, composant des surfaces brutes, presque telluriques.*\\nEntre textures, superpositions et jeux de transparence, chaque œuvre invite le regard à parcourir un univers mystérieux, où la matière semble conserver l’empreinte du temps.\\nUne exploration picturale puissante et sensible, à la frontière entre abstraction, matière et émotion.\\nTout Public\\nEntrée Libre"},{"t":1,"s":"Expo"},{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-01T11:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-05T11:00:00.000Z"},{"t":9,"i":2,"a":[{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-01T11:00:00.000Z"}],"o":0},{"t":9,"i":3,"a":[{"t":10,"i":4,"p":{"k":["debut","fin","heureFiable"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-01T11:00:00.000Z"},{"t":1,"s":"2026-12-05T11:00:00.000Z"},{"t":2,"s":3}]},"o":0}],"o":0},{"t":10,"i":5,"p":{"k":["name","commune","insee","codePostal","lat","lng"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"Village"},{"t":1,"s":"Saint-Cyprien"},{"t":1,"s":"66171"},{"t":1,"s":"66750"},{"t":0,"s":42.6177101},{"t":0,"s":3.0021719}]},"o":0},{"t":10,"i":6,"p":{"k":["url","mesure"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"https://cdt66.media.tourinsoft.eu/upload/event-FMALAR066V52ZK38-1792654700145.jpg"},{"t":10,"i":7,"p":{"k":["largeur","hauteur"],"v":[{"t":0,"s":905},{"t":0,"s":1280}]},"o":0}]},"o":0},{"t":0,"s":0},{"t":2,"s":3},{"t":0,"s":85},{"t":1,"s":"Tourinsoft (CDT66 — Fêtes)"},{"t":1,"s":"none"},{"t":1,"s":"declaree"},{"t":1,"s":"exposition"},{"t":10,"i":8,"p":{"k":["etat","champ"],"v":[{"t":1,"s":"gratuit"},{"t":1,"s":"DETAILFETEPAYANTE"}]},"o":0}]},"o":0},{"t":2,"s":1},{"t":11,"i":9,"p":{"k":[],"v":[]},"o":0}]},"o":0}
